comment: Port map for netlists/ctle_sp.cir: which nets are ports, what each
is referenced to, and what each one is. Nothing else.
Everything this file used to carry is derived now, or read from the
specification, and the tool refuses a stated value that disagrees
with what it derives. The port NUMBERS come from this list's order,
which is the only order ngspice accepts anyway; the differential
pairing comes from the roles; the deck is the netlist on the command
line; the bias is natural, which is the only correct choice; and
passivity is the largest singular value of the measured S-matrix.
The pass/fail bands and bars live in specs/ctle_sp_spec.md, because
a limit is a decision somebody signs and belongs in the document
reviewed with the design rather than in the measurement setup.
z0 in = 50 ohm: the receiver input is terminated to 100 ohm
differential by RT1/RT2 in the deck, which 2 x 50 ohm ports match.
z0 out = RD = 1000 ohm: the output IS a 1 kohm load node. A 50 ohm
port there would load the node to 47.6 ohm and measure a circuit
nobody builds, 26.4 dB down on this one.
Differential references are 2*z0: 100 ohm in, 2000 ohm out.
bias natural is the default and is not written here. Measured on a
source follower, a port written DC 0 instead moved the node from
243.8 mV to 7.7 mV and S21 by 7.8 dB, so the sweep would linearise
about an operating point the design does not have.
